intro.text: An older Threnodite woman, the tallest of the three members of the Greater Good on Canticle.
One of the Greater Good among the Beaconites on Canticle, whose duty is to state what she knows to be true with all the energy of her heart.

items.text: As one of the Greater Good leading the Beaconites, Confidence was charged with expressing what she knew to be true with the utmost energy of heart.

appearance.text: An older woman with medium-dark skin and blue eyes, and the tallest of the Greater Good. She usually wears a hat, small eyeglasses, gloves and a plain long black dress.
